title.zh: v2.0.31 钢琴卷帘 Logic Pro 级专业美化与双层 DAW 指令台重构：模块化双层控制台、立体 3D 象牙与黑曜石琴键、调式级数钻石导轨、亚克力高光音符块、棒棒糖力度控制器与直达虚拟键盘演奏
title.en: v2.0.31 Logic Pro-Grade Piano Roll Visual & Command Architecture Overhaul: Modular 2-deck command deck, 3D ivory & obsidian keybed, scale degree guide rails, acrylic glass note blocks, lollipop velocity lane, and direct Musical Typing HUD integration

highlights.zh: **模块化双层 DAW 指令控制台（2-Deck Command Deck）**：重塑原本拥挤无序的单行工具栏，构建清晰专业的双层分级控制台。Deck 1 集成轨道上下文中心（轨道切换、调式音阶微标、动态音符计数）、胶囊型主工具箱（指针 1、铅笔 2、橡皮 3、剪刀 4、框选 5，带荧光激活高光与快捷键角标）、力度泳道/播放头追随/展开收起/全屏及专属「Keys ⌥K」虚拟键盘快捷入口；Deck 2 集成时间网格（吸附与长度量化）、连音（Legato）、和弦编配大师组（Note/Triad/7th/9th/Sus4/Power 印章、和弦转位 ▲/▼、Drop-2 声部排列、人性化微时序抖动）、音高八度跨度调节（±12、8va/8vb）与多级视区缩放。层次分明，操作行云流水。
highlights.en: **Modular 2-Deck DAW Command Deck**: Replaced the cluttered single-line toolbar with an ergonomically stratified 2-deck control chassis. Deck 1 houses the Track Context Hub (selector, scale/key badge, note counter), Primary Tool Palette (Pointer 1, Pencil 2, Eraser 3, Scissors 4, Marquee 5 with radiant glow states and shortcut badges), view toggles (Velocity, Catch, Collapse, Fullscreen), and a dedicated "Keys ⌥K" Musical Typing launcher. Deck 2 houses timing & quantize cont…

highlights.zh: **立体 3D 象牙与黑曜石键盘（3D Ivory & Obsidian Keybed）**：彻底告别简陋扁平色块。黑键采用多段黑曜石渐变（#101217 → #242833），顶部倒角反光与投射到白键上的自然阴影，指针按下时呈现发光下潜反馈；白键采用象牙瓷釉高质感微渐变，并标注醒目 C3/C4/C5 八度标牌；琴键右缘嵌入调式级数光导轨，根音显示脉动旋转菱形钻标（Diamond Pin），调内音显示精细珍珠圆标，键盘与网格行实现亚像素级严格对齐。
highlights.en: **3D Ivory & Obsidian Piano Keybed**: Overhauled the pitch gutter with authentic tactile depth. Ebony keys feature multi-stop obsidian gradients (#101217 to #242833), top bevel highlights, and cast drop shadows with interactive depression feedback; ivory keys feature creamy enamel finishes and prominent octave badges (C3, C4, C5); and the keybed margin embeds luminous scale degree guide pins (pulsing diamond pips for roots, pearl pips for diatonic tones) perfectly aligned wi…

highlights.zh: **亚克力质感音符块与金属拉丝和弦走势标尺（Acrylic Glass Notes & Brushed Chord Ruler）**：网格音符升级为全圆角亚克力发光块体，顶部拥有细致的高光反射边缘（border-t border-white/60），左侧配备琴槌撞击瞬态标记（Hammer Transient Marker），并根据力度映射琥珀至亮珊瑚热力图渐变；顶部吸附小节线与和弦走向标尺采用金属拉丝风格，自动识别小节和弦徽章，轻点即可多音完整试听。
highlights.en: **Acrylic Glass Note Blocks & Brushed Chord Progression Ruler**: Pitch grid notes are elevated with acrylic glass capsules featuring top specular reflection rims, hammer strike transient impact lines, and velocity heatmap shading; the sticky timeline tape and chord progression ruler adopts a brushed dark metal texture, displaying harmonic badges that audition polyphonic chords upon clicking.
